  <div class="group-screen">

    <img class="group-image" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Smiling sun on the left and smiling moon on the right">
    <div class="group-options">
      <button class="group-choice" id="sunGroupBtn" type="button">☀️ Sun group</button>
      <button class="group-choice" id="moonGroupBtn" type="button">🌙 Moon group</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="task-participant" id="taskParticipant"></div>

  <div class="task">
    <div class="animal-row">
      <div class="animal"><div id="leftEmoji">🐶</div><div class="animal-label" id="leftName">Dog</div></div>
      <div class="animal"><div id="rightEmoji">🐱</div><div class="animal-label" id="rightName">Cat</div></div>

    <button id="downloadBtn">Download data</button>
    <button id="newBtn">Start next participant</button>

<script>
const GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwolCtFDVjMoElB9FYDG6rzRFbXCrOCzpDngbfgcMXm36-E5twHkLEKExMq0d6l-3CKYg/exec";

const ANIMAL_PAIRS = [
  { id: "A", left: { emoji: "🐕", name: "Dog", color: "#9a6500" }, right: { emoji: "🐈", name: "Cat", color: "#8f1d14" } },
  { id: "B", left: { emoji: "🐘", name: "Elephant", color: "#777777" }, right: { emoji: "🦁", name: "Lion", color: "#d78320" } },
  { id: "C", left: { emoji: "🐄", name: "Cow", color: "#333333" }, right: { emoji: "🐖", name: "Pig", color: "#d78378" } },
  { id: "D", left: { emoji: "🐢", name: "Turtle", color: "#287a3e" }, right: { emoji: "🦏", name: "Rhino", color: "#777777" } }
];

  const state = {
  participant: null,
  participantNumber: null,
  sequence: [],
  roundIndex: 0,
  phase: 1,
  roundData: [],
  current: null,
  answerPosition: null,
  trialStart: null,
  activePointerId: null
};

function show(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(el => el.classList.add("hidden"));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove("hidden");
}
function requestCentralParticipantNumber() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const callbackName = "participantNumberCallback_" + Date.now() + "_" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
    const script = document.createElement("script");
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      cleanup();
      reject(new Error("Could not obtain a participant number from the server."));
    }, 15000);
    function cleanup() {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      try { delete window[callbackName]; } catch (_) { window[callbackName] = undefined; }
      script.remove();
    }
    window[callbackName] = response => {
      cleanup();
      if (response && Number.isInteger(Number(response.participantNumber)) && Number(response.participantNumber) > 0) {
        resolve(Number(response.participantNumber));
      } else {
        reject(new Error("The server returned an invalid participant number."));
      }
    };
    script.onerror = () => { cleanup(); reject(new Error("Could not connect to the participant-number server.")); };
    script.src = GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL + "?action=nextId&callback=" + encodeURIComponent(callbackName) + "&t=" + Date.now();
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
}
function permutations(items) {
  if (items.length <= 1) return [items.slice()];
  const result = [];
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    const rest = items.slice(0, i).concat(items.slice(i + 1));
    permutations(rest).forEach(tail => result.push([item, ...tail]));
  });
  return result;
}
const ALL_ORDERS = permutations([0,1,2,3]);

async function setupParticipant() {
  const startBtn = document.getElementById("startBtn");
  startBtn.disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("participantDisplay").textContent = "Assigning participant number…";
  try {
    state.participantNumber = await requestCentralParticipantNumber();
    state.participant = "P" + String(state.participantNumber).padStart(3, "0");
    // Participants 1–24 receive each of the 24 orders once; then the cycle repeats.
    state.sequence = ALL_ORDERS[(state.participantNumber - 1) % ALL_ORDERS.length].slice();
    state.roundIndex = 0;
    state.phase = 1;
    state.roundData = [];
    document.getElementById("participantDisplay").textContent = "Participant " + state.participant;
    startBtn.disabled = false;
  } catch (error) {
    document.getElementById("participantDisplay").textContent = "Could not assign a participant number. Check the connection and tap Retry.";
    startBtn.textContent = "Retry";
    startBtn.disabled = false;
    console.error(error);
  }
}
function currentPair() {
  const pairIndex = state.sequence[state.roundIndex];
  const original = ANIMAL_PAIRS[pairIndex];
  // Balance which animal is on the left across participants.
  const swap = ((state.participantNumber + pairIndex) % 2 === 0);
  const left = swap ? original.right : original.left;
  const right = swap ? original.left : original.right;
  return { id: original.id, pairIndex, left, right, orderPosition: state.roundIndex + 1 };
}
function renderPair() {
  state.current = currentPair();
  const p = state.current;
  document.getElementById("roundDisplay").textContent =
    `Round ${state.roundIndex + 1} of 4 · Pair ${p.id} · Step ${state.phase} of 2`;
  document.getElementById("leftEmoji").textContent = p.left.emoji;
  document.getElementById("leftName").textContent = p.left.name;
  document.getElementById("rightEmoji").textContent = p.right.emoji;
  document.getElementById("rightName").textContent = p.right.name;
  document.querySelector(".scale-line").style.background =
    `linear-gradient(90deg, ${p.left.color} 0%, color-mix(in srgb, ${p.left.color} 50%, white) 25%, #ffffff 50%, color-mix(in srgb, ${p.right.color} 50%, white) 75%, ${p.right.color} 100%)`;
  document.getElementById("taskParticipant").textContent = state.participant || "";
  document.getElementById("instruction").textContent = "";

  const marker = document.getElementById("firstMarker");
  const label = document.getElementById("firstLabel");
  if (state.phase === 2) {
    const first = state.roundData[state.roundData.length - 1];
    marker.style.left = (first.first_position * 100) + "%";
    label.style.left = (first.first_position * 100) + "%";
    marker.classList.remove("hidden");
    label.classList.remove("hidden");
  } else {
    marker.classList.add("hidden");
    label.classList.add("hidden");
  }
  document.getElementById("handle").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("value").textContent = "";
  document.getElementById("continueBtn").disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("continueBtn").textContent =
    state.phase === 1 ? "Continue" : (state.roundIndex === 3 ? "Finish" : "Next pair");
  state.answerPosition = null;
  state.trialStart = performance.now();
  show("task");
}
function positionFromEvent(event) {
  const rect = document.getElementById("scale").getBoundingClientRect();
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
}
function setAnswer(position) {
  state.answerPosition = position;
  const handle = document.getElementById("handle");
  handle.style.left = (position * 100) + "%";
  handle.classList.remove("hidden");
  document.getElementById("value").textContent = "";
  document.getElementById("continueBtn").disabled = false;
}
const scale = document.getElementById("scale");
scale.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  state.activePointerId = event.pointerId;
  scale.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  setAnswer(positionFromEvent(event));
});
scale.addEventListener("pointermove", event => {
  if (state.activePointerId === event.pointerId) setAnswer(positionFromEvent(event));
});
function endPointer(event) {
  if (state.activePointerId === event.pointerId) state.activePointerId = null;
}
scale.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
scale.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);

function submitRoundToGoogleSheets(row) {
  const payload = JSON.stringify(row);
  if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
    navigator.sendBeacon(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, new Blob([payload], {type:"text/plain;charset=utf-8"}));
  } else {
    fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {method:"POST", mode:"no-cors", headers:{"Content-Type":"text/plain;charset=utf-8"}, body:payload});
  }
}
function finishStep() {
  const pos = state.answerPosition;
  const rt = Math.round(performance.now() - state.trialStart);
  const value = Math.round(pos * 100);
  const pair = state.current;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  if (state.phase === 1) {
    state.roundData.push({
      participant: state.participant,
      participant_number: state.participantNumber,
      group: state.group,
      round_number: state.roundIndex + 1,
      order_position: pair.orderPosition,
      pair_id: pair.id,
      left_animal: pair.left.emoji,
      right_animal: pair.right.emoji,
      left_label: pair.left.name,
      right_label: pair.right.name,
      first_position: pos,
      first_value_0_to_100: value,
      first_RT_ms: rt,
      first_timestamp: now
    });
    state.phase = 2;
    renderPair();
    return;
  }

  const row = state.roundData[state.roundData.length - 1];
  row.second_position = pos;
  row.second_value_0_to_100 = value;
  row.change_from_first = value - row.first_value_0_to_100;
  row.direction_from_first = value > row.first_value_0_to_100 ? "higher" :
    value < row.first_value_0_to_100 ? "lower" : "unchanged";
  row.second_RT_ms = rt;
  row.second_timestamp = now;
  row.submitted_timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

  // Send one row per animal pair, after both answers are complete.
  submitRoundToGoogleSheets(row);

  state.roundIndex += 1;
  if (state.roundIndex < 4) {
    state.phase = 1;
    renderPair();
  } else {
    document.getElementById("finishParticipant").textContent = "Participant ID: " + state.participant;
    show("finish");
  }
}
document.getElementById("continueBtn").addEventListener("click", finishStep);
document.getElementById("startBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  // If no participant number was obtained during page load, retry the request.
  if (!state.participantNumber || !state.sequence.length) {
    await setupParticipant();
    if (!state.participantNumber || !state.sequence.length) return;
  }
  show("groupSelect");
});
document.getElementById("sunGroupBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  state.group = "sun";
  renderPair();
});
document.getElementById("moonGroupBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  state.group = "moon";
  renderPair();
});
document.getElementById("newBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  state.group = null;
  show("start");
  await setupParticipant();
});
document.getElementById("downloadBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const columns = [
    "participant","participant_number","group","round_number","order_position","pair_id",
    "left_animal","right_animal","left_label","right_label",
    "first_position","first_value_0_to_100","first_RT_ms","first_timestamp",
    "second_position","second_value_0_to_100","change_from_first","direction_from_first",
    "second_RT_ms","second_timestamp","submitted_timestamp"
  ];
  const escape = v => '"' + String(v ?? "").replaceAll('"','""') + '"';
  const csv = [columns.join(","), ...state.roundData.map(row => columns.map(c => escape(row[c])).join(","))].join("\n");
  const blob = new Blob([csv], {type:"text/csv;charset=utf-8;"});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `confidence_scale_${state.participant}.csv`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
});

// Request a centrally allocated participant number before the participant starts.
setupParticipant();
</script>
</body>
</html>
